message.content:
This vertical editorial illustration serves as a magazine cover for "TEMPO," dated "8-14 FEBRUARI 2016." The upper third features the masthead and headlines over a white background with a red vertical border on the left. The lower two-thirds depict a cartoon set in a flat, sandy landscape under a blue sky with white clouds.

In the center, a white, blue, and purple high-speed train car sits atop three horizontal, cylindrical wooden logs. These logs serve as rollers on the ground. A fourth log is being carried by a person on the right. One man in a white shirt and dark trousers pushes the back of the train car from the left. On the right, a woman in a white shirt and dark trousers runs toward the front of the train, carrying a large log over her shoulder. Dust clouds appear behind her feet.

The main headline reads "CEPAT-CEPAT KERETA CEPAT" in large black and red slanted text. Smaller black text below discusses the Jakarta-Bandung express train project. At the bottom, a barcode, the price "RP 39.500," and "WWW.TEMPO.CO" are visible.
